# AgentOre v0.0.9

AgentOre v0.0.9 is a focused macOS dashboard clarity and layout release.

## Changes

- makes `Pending Tokens` the single primary metric;
- reduces the last accepted submission and Lifetime usage to compact supporting lines;
- combines Epoch progress and the live countdown on one row;
- hides routine status text while retaining meaningful action and error feedback;
- derives panel height from its actual content instead of a fixed value;
- prevents the wallet address, balances, and status from being compressed or clipped;
- describes the menu-bar value as pending token delta.

## Install

1. Download `AgentOre-v0.0.9-macos-universal.zip` and its `.sha256` file.
2. Verify the checksum.
3. Unzip and move `AgentOre.app` to `/Applications`.

The app requires macOS 14 or newer. This release is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized.
